description: Authored verification evidence per (capability, implementation). Levels are evidence claims and are never inferred from test or code presence. execution_mode (REAL/SIMULATED/MOCK) records how the evidence was produced and is required whenever the level is above DECLARED. The capability catalog merges these records; this file is not a capability authority and must not duplicate manifest- or registry-owned data.
